description: Index of evidence records. Each entry binds an evidence_record_id to a run-artifact file and its SHA-256. The gate re-hashes every artifact and compares it against both this registry and the citing claim; any mismatch fails. The registry is the single index; the artifact files under docs/evidence/runs/ are the evidence.

run_artifact.description: Repo-relative path of the artifact file, e.g. docs/evidence/runs/EV-20261106-suite.json.

title: TextForensics evidence registry (U7 claim-to-evidence gate)
